issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 06 requires selecting municipalities with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses thresholds of 10,000 for both (WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This numeric threshold mismatch is structural and will confuse students about the expected condition and lead to incorrect/explainable results.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the numeric threshold between the problem statement and the solution. Update solution in aufgabe06.sql to use WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000 (replace 10000 with 100000), or alternatively adjust the problem text to require 10,000 if that was intended.
